assets.produced_prompt: Create one isolated overhead car sprite for a bright, rounded cartoon parking game. Use the attached picture only as a STYLE reference: chunky rounded shapes, very thick smooth dark navy ink outlines, cheerful saturated pastel colors, simple two-tone cel shading and a few broad white glints. The sprite must be a TRUE 90-degree bird's-eye view looking straight down, with the front of the car pointing directly toward the TOP of the image. No isometric view, no perspective, no visible front grille face. Entire vehicle including all four side tires visible. Height approximately twice the width, centered with a generous transparent margin. Rounded black tires, pale blue front windshield, darker rear window, clearly readable headlights at the TOP and tiny red tail lights at the BOTTOM. No lettering, no brand, no face, no labels, no scene, no floor or cast shadow outside the body. Fully transparent background. Polished mobile game art that stays clear at a 35 by 65 pixel display size. A plump coral-red compact hatchback, slightly wide rounded roof, creamy pink highlights, small square sunroof, cute chunky bumpers.
assets.description: player coral overhead transparent car sprite
